detail: sentence 1, "It is for your blood pressure {{dose:m1}}", does not match a valid sentence shape. A sentence with a dose, route, frequency, sig, or daily slot must match one of these shapes, with no other words and every slot naming the same order: Take {{drug:m1}} {{dose:m1}}. Take {{drug:m1}} {{route:m1}}. Take {{drug:m1}} {{frequency:m1}}. Take {{drug:m1}} {{sig:m1}}. Your dose of {{drug:m1}} is {{dose:m1}}. Your total of {{drug:m1}} is {{daily:m1}}. A daily total may also end: which is {{daily:m1}}.
